domain_verifications_method_fields.name: domain_verifications_method_fields
domain_verifications_method_fields.value:
CASE "domain_verifications"."method"
        WHEN 'dns_txt' THEN "domain_verifications"."challenge_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "domain_verifications"."reason" IS NULL
        ELSE "domain_verifications"."challenge_hash" IS NULL AND "domain_verifications"."reason" IS NOT NULL END

domains_fqdn_normalised.name: domains_fqdn_normalised
domains_fqdn_normalised.value: "domains"."fqdn" = lower("domains"."fqdn") AND "domains"."fqdn" NOT LIKE '%.' AND length("domains"."fqdn") <= 253

assets_hostname_normalised.name: assets_hostname_normalised
assets_hostname_normalised.value: "assets"."hostname" = lower("assets"."hostname") AND "assets"."hostname" NOT LIKE '%.' AND length("assets"."hostname") <= 253

assets_approval_consistent.name: assets_approval_consistent
assets_approval_consistent.value: "assets"."verification_status" <> 'approved' OR ("assets"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "assets"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL)

approved_networks_revoke_reason.name: approved_networks_revoke_reason
approved_networks_revoke_reason.value: "approved_networks"."revoked_at" is null or "approved_networks"."revoke_reason" is not null

scan_jobs_lease_when_active.name: scan_jobs_lease_when_active
scan_jobs_lease_when_active.value: "scan_jobs"."status" NOT IN ('claimed', 'running') OR ("scan_jobs"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "scan_jobs"."worker_id" IS NOT NULL)

findings_accepted_risk_complete.name: findings_accepted_risk_complete
findings_accepted_risk_complete.value: "findings"."status" <> 'accepted_risk' OR ("findings"."accepted_risk_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "findings"."accepted_risk_approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "findings"."accepted_risk_review_at" IS NOT NULL)
